description: Na₂FeAlF₇ crystallizes in the monoclinic C2/c space group. There are six inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded to eight F atoms to form distorted NaF₈ hexagonal bipyramids that share  a cornercorner with one NaF₈ hexagonal bipyramid, corners with two AlF₆ octahedra, edges with two equivalent AlF₆ octahedra, and edges with four FeF₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 43-54°. There are a spread of Na-F bond distances ranging from 2.19-2.75 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded to eight F atoms to form NaF₈ hexagonal bipyramids that share corners with two equivalent NaF₈ hexagonal bipyramids, corners with two equivalent AlF₆ octahedra, edges with two equivalent AlF₆ octahedra, and edges with four FeF₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 45°. There are a spread of Na-F bond distances ranging from 2.23-2.69 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight F atoms. There are a spread of Na-F bond distances ranging from 2.31-2.88 Å. In the fourth Na site, Na is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight F atoms. There are a spread of Na-F bond distances ranging from 2.42-2.92 Å. In the fifth Na site, Na is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight F atoms. There are a spread of Na-F bond distances ranging from 2.44-2.88 Å. In the sixth Na site, Na is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight F atoms. There are a spread of Na-F bond distances ranging from 2.47-2.91 Å. There are two inequivalent Fe sites. In the first Fe site, Fe is bonded to six F atoms to form FeF₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent FeF₆ octahedra, corners with four AlF₆ octahedra, and edges with three NaF₈ hexagonal bipyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 37-59°. There are a spread of Fe-F bond distances ranging from 2.06-2.09 Å. In the second Fe site, Fe is bonded to six F atoms to form FeF₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent FeF₆ octahedra, corners with four AlF₆ octahedra, and edges with three NaF₈ hexagonal bipyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 34-59°. There are a spread of Fe-F bond distances ranging from 2.06-2.10 Å. There are three inequivalent Al sites. In the first Al site, Al is bonded to six F atoms to form AlF₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaF₈ hexagonal bipyramids and corners with four FeF₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 38-41°. There are a spread of Al-F bond distances ranging from 1.81-1.84 Å. In the second Al site, Al is bonded to six F atoms to form AlF₆ octahedra that share  a cornercorner with one NaF₈ hexagonal bipyramid, corners with four FeF₆ octahedra, and edges with two equivalent NaF₈ hexagonal bipyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 39-41°. There are a spread of Al-F bond distances ranging from 1.82-1.84 Å. In the third Al site, Al is bonded to six F atoms to form AlF₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaF₈ hexagonal bipyramids, corners with four FeF₆ octahedra, and edges with two equivalent NaF₈ hexagonal bipyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 34-37°. There are a spread of Al-F bond distances ranging from 1.81-1.86 Å. There are fourteen inequivalent F sites. In the first F site, F is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to three Na and one Al atom. In the second F site, F is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to two Na, one Fe, and one Al atom. In the third F site, F is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na, one Fe, and one Al atom. In the fourth F site, F is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na, one Fe, and one Al atom. In the fifth F site, F is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na, one Fe, and one Al atom. In the sixth F site, F is bonded to three Na and one Al atom to form distorted corner-sharing FNa₃Al tetrahedra. In the seventh F site, F is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to two Na, one Fe, and one Al atom. In the eighth F site, F is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na, one Fe, and one Al atom. In the ninth F site, F is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to two Na, one Fe, and one Al atom. In the tenth F site, F is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na and two Fe atoms. In the eleventh F site, F is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na and two Fe atoms. In the twelfth F site, F is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to three Na and one Al atom. In the thirteenth F site, F is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na, one Fe, and one Al atom. In the fourteenth F site, F is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to three Na and one Al atom.
